### How this work is cited

Passages inside Republic are identified by stephanus page and section (e.g. iv 433a). Socrates is the principal speaker. The dialogue's argument is conducted by the characters, and the archive therefore presents passages under Socrates while citing the work to Plato — the distinction the corpus's \`author\` field flattens.

### The work in Plato’s thought

Plato (c. 428/427–348/347 BCE) was an Athenian of high birth, a devoted associate of Socrates, and the founder of the Academy. [More on Plato](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/plato) .
